array.string: Fixed missing Mega/Alolan/Galarian/etc forms on the National Pokédex. National Pokédex now shows all possible forms for each Pokémon.
Fixed move learnsets for alternate forms and the National Pokédex
PikaDex has been rewritten from the ground up, leading to better performance and stability!

Initial Scarlet/Violet support. Note: these games are very new and information is still being discovered and documented. Some info might be missing or incorrect. Please use the contact form if you find any errors.
Implemented Caught Pokemon tracking (Beta): Swipe on a Pokémon or long press to mark it as caught.
Added Home button to conveniently jump back to the home screen.
Added Links to Bulbapedia and PokemonDB for Pokémon, Moves, Items, Locations, Abilities and Types.
Universal Search: Search for Pokémon, Moves, Items, Locations, Abilities, etc all from one search bar on the home screen!
Search by national number on the Pokémon list
